title: 第42章 一样的死法
content_zh:
第42章 一样的死法-《我发现了世界BUG》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“.......这是重点吗？”

林舒语气无奈，而那头的谢雨迟却是不依不饶地追问道：

“你跟谁在一起？”

“我说了徐长顺的事情你不要再去管了，这件事情没那么简单！”

她的话说完，林舒没什么特别的反应，倒是一旁的陆染微微眯起了眼睛。

电话对面这个女孩子很激动啊.....

哦，她应该就是林舒的那个朋友，在二院工作的那个。

她能看出来徐长顺的死不简单，让林舒尽可能远离也是正常的。

不过，只是因为一道符箓、还有林舒身边的“陌生人”，就能判断出林舒还在掺和这件事情，本身也是一种极其敏锐的直觉了。

那么敏锐，她那里会有线索吗？

如果有可能的话，得想办法分出点人手，再去她那边探一探.....

“我现在很难跟你解释......”

林舒犹豫片刻，转头看向陆染。

后者冲他摇了摇头，示意他暂时不要说破。

“那个符是保平安的，你暂时先.......”

陆染做出一个“留下”的口型。

“暂时先留下。”

“我这两天还要出差一趟，等我回来再跟你解释。”

“你最好解释清楚。”

谢雨迟沉声道：

“不然我就得找你妈了。”

“......你多大了还告家长？？”

“这不是告家长，林舒！这件事情很危险！我不想你因为这种莫名其妙的事情出事！”

“......知道了，知道了。”

林舒敷衍地回应，那一头，谢雨迟直接挂断了电话。

“她很关心你。”

陆染语气调侃地问道：

“小女朋友啊？”

“发小.......破煞符是什么情况？”

陆染看着林舒递过来的手机上的图片，解释道：

“这是九天玄女破煞符，法脉相传是孙思邈飞神谒帝时，由九天玄女亲授的默告捷要之文，在道法会元里有记载。”

“这道符是用于解厄祛病的，但功能比较狭窄，而且真实有效的仪轨也早就失传了。”

“我们从来没用过这套仪轨，不知道它有效还是无效----但是这也不重要。”

“重点是，有人在你不知情的情况下，把这东西放在了你车上。”

“他对你应该是好意吧？”

“但我想不明白，为什么他不光明正大地干呢？”

“......我也想不明白。”

林舒摊了摊手。

“不过，你们把他找出来不就行了。”

“我把车子的行驶轨迹提供给你，现在到处都是监控，你们去调一调监控，自然就能找到那个人了。”

“搞不好，他那里还有新的线索呢？”

“很棒！”

陆染竖起大拇指。

"...Is this the point?"

Lin Shu's tone was helpless, but Xie Yuchi on the other end asked relentlessly:

"Who are you with?"

"I told you not to interfere with Xu Changshun's matter anymore. This matter is not that simple!"

After she finished speaking, Lin Shu had no special reaction, but Lu Ran beside him narrowed his eyes slightly.

The girl on the other side of the phone was very excited...

Oh, she should be Lin Shu's friend, the one who works in the Second Hospital.

She could see that Xu Changshun's death was not simple, and it was normal for Lin Shu to stay as far away as possible.

However, just because of a talisman and the "stranger" around Lin Shu, he could tell that Lin Shu was still involved in this matter, which was an extremely keen intuition in itself.

So sharp, will she have any clues?

If possible, we have to find a way to allocate some manpower and go to her place to explore...

"It's hard for me to explain to you now..."

Lin Shu hesitated for a moment, then turned to look at Lu Ran.

The latter shook his head at him, indicating that he should not tell the truth for the time being.

"That talisman is for safety. For the time being..."

Lu Ran made a "stay" mouth gesture.

"Stay here for now."

"I'm going on a business trip in the next two days. I'll explain to you when I get back."

"You'd better explain."

Xie Yuchi said in a deep voice:

"Otherwise I'll have to find your mother."

"...How old are you to sue your parents??"

"This is not about suing the parents, Lin Shu! This matter is very dangerous! I don't want you to get into trouble because of such an inexplicable thing!"

"... Got it, got it."

Lin Shu responded perfunctorily, and on the other end, Xie Yuchi hung up the phone.

"She cares about you."

Lu Ran asked in a teasing tone:

"Little girlfriend?"

"Fa Xiao...what's going on with the evil-breaking talisman?"

Lu Ran looked at the pictures on the phone handed over by Lin Shu and explained:

"This is the Jiutian Xuannv's evil-breaking talisman. According to legend, it was a tacit victory message given by the Nine Heavens Xuannv to Sun Simiao when he visited the emperor. It is recorded in the Taoist Fahui Yuanli."

"This talisman is used to relieve misfortune and cure diseases, but its function is relatively narrow, and the real and effective ritual has been lost long ago."

"We have never used this ritual, so we don't know if it works or not - but it doesn't matter."

"The point is, someone put this thing in your car without your knowledge."

"He must have good intentions towards you, right?"

"But I don't understand why he didn't do it openly?"

"...I can't figure it out either."

Lin Shu spread his hands.

"But you can just find him."

"I will provide you with the driving trajectory of the car. There are surveillance cameras everywhere now. If you adjust the surveillance cameras, you will naturally be able to find that person."

"Maybe he has new clues?"

“Great!”

Lu Ran gave a thumbs up.
